relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Headache frequency and days of symptomatic medication use improved significantly after 6 months, with no significant differences between the FM and non-FM groups.

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Somatic pain, as measured by the 0–10 numeric rating scale, also improved significantly

key_findings: Anti-CGRP mAbs improved migraine similarly in patients with and without fibromyalgia and also reduced FIQ disability and somatic pain.
FIQ improvement correlated with MIDAS improvement (r=0.55).
